text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning numerous races with 
Mejiro Dober...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was just doing my work like usual, 
...but somehow, I feel someone's gaze on 
me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...All you have to do is say it. 'The time 
has come for both of us to settle down, 
right?'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, you look busy today too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"If she turns me down, I just have to hand 
over the ticket without fuss. That still 
gets the job done, after all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If I invite them at a time like this, I'll 
probably just get in the way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
This is just me returning what you always 
do for me. So—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Still. Even so. The time we have to 
cherish one another is surely limited.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Take this step, too. Come on, me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer! How about that New Year's 
thing! Wanna go on a hot springs trip?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Let's go on that hot springs trip 
we won on New Year's!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And let's take it easy together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ......How was the bath?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I see. In that case... umm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding a hand to her face as if 
hesitating, Mejiro Dober stares off into 
space—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...What should we do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right... I'm the one who invited her. 
If I'm hosting, I should've come with a 
plan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah... no good. Even though I decided to 
properly take care of myself...
choice_data_list: Not at all. I'm plenty relaxed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...That's not good enough, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, led by Mejiro Dober, I ended up 
going for a walk outside with her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...I just heard from the innkeeper. They 
said the stars look beautiful from here."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by her words, I look up at the 
sky. Surrounded by nothing but nature, the 
light shining from the heavens was crystal 
clear.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Wait! ...Don't just agree with that so 
easily."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Spending all this time together with you 
made me realize something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Underneath it all, you're actually the 
type who worries a lot about others, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No matter how outrageous her actions or 
words may be, deep down, she's always 
thinking of doing it for someone else 
rather than herself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...You're just too kind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If you don't like it, just say so. Just 
like earlier, you had every right to get 
angry at me for not being prepared.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You could have turned down this hot spring 
trip, you know. You're an adult, Trainer, 
so you might have been able to relax more 
if you went with someone else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
――As expected, you nod without turning 
down the invitation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...You can just tell me how you really 
feel.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Don't prioritize me and hide who you 
are."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
When you don't want to go... When you 
don't want to do something, just say no.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list: That's why I'm here with you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... There you go saying things like 
that again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's perfectly fine to slack off 
once in a while, you know? ...I mean it, 
okay?”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise... I might end up taking those 
words to heart, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, while stargazing for a while, I 
slowly walked back to the inn with Mejiro 
Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, good night. We're leaving 
here at 10 tomorrow, so Trainer, make sure 
you're――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What is it?
choice_data_list:
I really thought the stars here were 
beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And let's take it easy together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. The view was amazing, just like the 
reviews said. Did you get to relax in the 
hot springs too, Trainer?"
choice_data_list:
Yeah, and my skin feels super moisturized 
too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Right! It said it's great for your skin 
too. I'm so glad I invited you."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you've been working non-stop 
lately... Haven't there been days where 
you couldn't get a proper night's sleep?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Still, as I thought, to my eyes, it 
sometimes looks like you're pushing 
yourself too hard, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. Want to go get some fresh 
night air with me for a bit?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Just for a tiny bit, so you don't catch 
a chill from getting out of the bath.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Without any streetlights or anything, it 
gets pitch black out here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine. I'm not alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Trainer. When we first met, you 
were still just a sub-trainer, weren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I was way more shy around 
people than I am now. Yet Trainer was just 
as patient and kind as they are today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...You always believed in me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. The other day, I reviewed the 
training plan Trainer put together for me. 
All the way from the Junior class up until 
now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And so, the intensity's been ramping up 
bit by bit. Well, that's only natural, of 
course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it really made me realize 
something again. ...That this person 
genuinely, from the bottom of their heart, 
believed that I could go even further.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Those eyes of yours haven't 
changed one bit since back then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Those eyes give me courage.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "...Hey, Trainer. I have a favor to ask."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"There are still so many paths I want to 
sprint down."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
To prove who Mejiro Dober is. To forge a 
brand-new light for the Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"To make that happen, I don't want to 
stop. I can't afford to stop now."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
However, please don't just stand by and 
watch it slip away. Until the day comes... 
when nothing more ...can truly be done.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Let's keep making them come true 
together. Let's keep making our dreams 
come true, together."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —Let's keep running together from now on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So please don't push yourself too hard. 
...Don't shoulder everything on your own.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as we discussed what lies ahead, I 
walked back to the inn with Mejiro Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No. I just noticed that when you get 
absorbed in conversation, Trainer, your 
walking pace speeds up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. I was able to realize that you 
had this side to you, too—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ――...Somehow, it makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Mejiro Dober...
